Mark your calendar, Pasco. 📌 Teen Heart Throb: An All Kings Drag Show is taking over Azucar and it's unlike anything you've seen on la pista. Cherry Pop hosts, and dancing King Slayonce is bringing performances you will NOT forget — boy-band swagger, heartthrob choreography, the whole package. This is an all-Kings night built for maximum chaos and maximum fun. Doors open early, tickets move fast, and the squad that gets here first claims the best spot on the floor. Round up your crew, get dressed up, and don't sleep on this one — nights like this sell out before people even realize it's happening.

🗓️ Sunday, November 15 • Doors 7pm / Show 8pm
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
🎟️ $10 online / $15 at the door
🔞 18+

Lights go low, bass drops, and suddenly you're back in middle school except now there's a drink in your hand. 🎤✨ Cherry Pop hosts a stage full of Kings serving heartthrob energy — sharp choreography, boy-band swagger, that electric feeling right before the chorus hits. Dancing King Slayonce is on deck bringing performances that'll leave the whole room buzzing. The floor gets packed, the energy gets loud, and every set feels like a flashback with better lighting. Sweaty, nostalgic, unforgettable — this is the kind of night Azucar does best.

Whoever had a poster on their wall, a crush on a boy-band member, or a heart that still skips a beat at that one song — this night is for you. 💖 Teen Heart Throb brings an all-Kings lineup to Azucar, hosted by Cherry Pop, with dancing King Slayonce ready to steal the spotlight. No judgment, no pretending you're too cool — this is a room for everybody to show up exactly as the fan they always were. Bring your friends, bring your group chat, bring the energy, and let la pista do the rest. Azucar is for the whole Latinx community to come together, dress the part, and lose it to the music.
